record.question: Which country is known as the land of cakes?
record.explanation: Answer C: Scotland. Scotland is the conventional Land of Cakes. Burns' original poem on Captain Grose addresses the Land o' Cakes and fellow Scots; the National Trust for Scotland holds and describes the manuscript. Historical/source note: Traditional literary nickname, referring to Scotland. Reference: https://www.nts.org.uk/collections/object/object-110004803. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
